question: Can a fixed-capacity shared causal relationship weight matrix be repaired after contradictory environmental revisions, retaining unaffected old-world predictions while actively learning unfamiliar four-parent operators at equal data and compute cost relative to strong conventional replay/Bayesian?
hypothesis: Subtract-old/add-new direct updates in an existing fixed pair-association matrix will preserve unaffected contexts while avoiding reconstructing the matrix from every historical episode; it may be faster than exact replay but must not be credited for a win if an equally informed indexed conventional counter achieves parity.
predecessor_evidence: FKP-06 PR #1097 source-HEAD 845cc614915fa26f3377136b4635bae2a16276f5; source headroom PASS with 12 active predictions 0.65869 and 64 active 1.0 over 107880 four-parent nonlinear hypotheses; source and G29 exact-SHA dual-OS run #43718608576 SUCCESS.

FKP-05 prereg 426605fec01886fe7436e79a43addd44cc314241, learned prior DEV gain but equal-info exact Bayesian TIE, source headroom NO-GO, contradicted contexts stored as separate posterior slots, source-only DEV consumed.

Yggdrasil accepted main is 5e74f8db85b2f5839c42148c0dfba69a88b1a2c9 (tree 180008502f6bdfe5a06c3d0d6f47f941dd01f20b); actual native PublicCausalCells remains separate. Issue #1088 admission conditional on independent science.

inputs.name: FKP-07 original synthetic four-parent XOR-of-AND DEV world protocol (not blinded science)
inputs.source: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 spec: FKP07-V1|four-parent XOR-of-AND|32-input|107880 laws|24 original worlds 800..823|8 revisions 840..847|64 paid actions per version|prefixes 4,8,12,16,32,64|256 held per world|shared 496 signed-pair counters|32 context slots|owner primary 1800..1863 unopened|dev seed HMAC|active query unweighted exact version space|strong independent replay Bayesian|no native promotion. Source code and original implementation must be committed, hash-pinned and qualified before DEV exposure.

seeds.original: 800..823 inclusive, 24 original worlds, disjoint from consumed FKP-06 700..723
seeds.revisions: 840..847 inclusive map to contexts 800..807; eight genuinely contradictory revision worlds
seeds.protected_primary: 1800..1863, NEVER instantiated by development or GitHub, independent source owner key required
seeds.source_pool: FKP06 deterministic 128 action/256 held inputs; disjoint world law selections and outcomes from FKP06, no new source-held action reuse as scientific first-use

frozen_design.split: 32 binary causal input dimensions; each hidden law is XOR of two pairwise ANDs with four essential parents. 107,880 public valid candidate causal programs. 24 disjoint original worlds sample private DEV target via SHA-256 source-only key, with revision worlds changing one of two parent-pairs, so old and new causal laws differ. No learner is supplied any hidden parent ID, target index or source-private key. Each of 24 original plus eight revisions gets at most 64 genuine public action/consequence observations from 128 possible, with predictions checked after prefixes 4/8/12/16/32/64 and frozen held set of 256.
frozen_design.ordering: Source actions selected by deterministic FKP-06 exact active version-space split heuristic independent of target; all arms see IDENTICAL action/outcome sequence and source order, no information advantage due to policy. Original seeds=800..823, revise first eight via seeds 840..847 in ascending order. Seal all model predictions and per-context law-commit before reading DEV held answers. Protected evaluator not used.
frozen_design.data_budget: 24*64+8*64=2,048 source-paid 32-bit interventions and 2,048 source-observed binary outcomes; each control gets same logged action transcript. No additional private world queries, no prior true law data in learner. FKP-06 law family is public, an exact reference is NOT evidence of novel open-ended law invention.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Stdlib CPython 3.12, CPU-only. Up to 107,880 law candidates, 128 public action bitmasks, 256 held masks, 32 context slots and 496 shared unordered-pair signed counters. Fixed 496 unsigned 16-bit global counts plus 32 four-parent law identifiers encoded in 4 bytes each; 1,120 bytes raw model-state, excluding provenance, HMAC and evaluation. Every algorithm must report full source and inference, initial discovery, revision search, cold snapshot, peak memory and whole-process CPU+wall time. Compare direct subtract/add, naive destructive overwrite, full replay rebuild of identical 496 pair counters from 32 stored learned law IDs, and independent Bayesian exact same-policy inference. No resource claims without full matched process and data.
frozen_design.capacity: 32 contexts maximum; each has one CURRENT four-parent law identifier (encoded as four exact bytes) stored in a fixed ring/array; context after revision repairs SAME slot, never appends another context/version slot. 496 shared pair weights aggregate two pairwise components from all live context laws, updated in-place. This necessarily forgets obsolete context versions by design; retention criterion is for 16+ unaffected still-current contexts, not original obsolete version truth. No native Yggdrasil accepted weights or control signals touched.
frozen_design.evaluator: Held accuracy @6 budget prefixes for every world and per-context repair; strong posterior source reference, at 64 must uniquely identify law in >=90% worlds and get >=0.98 held accuracy or stop as source mismatch. After first 24 worlds, revise first 8, record exactly unchanged held predictions for 16 unaffected contexts and corrected revised-context held accuracy. If first 64 not singleton, count nonidentifiable and abstain, never use source truth to choose model law. Cold restore bitwise prediction parity and checksum, corrupted snapshot fails. Negative controls: naive overwrite of shared weights, replaying all 32 saved law IDs to rebuild counters, and fully trained conventional Bayesian using equal action/outcome transcript; model architecture and counts/bytes/timings disclosed.
frozen_design.source_fence: Research evaluator DEV key/public seeds available to source owner only. Protected source seeds/key do not appear in GitHub, workflow or ChatGPT model messages; no protected first-use attempted. The source class (including private fields) never passed as learner input.
frozen_design.interpretation: An equal-information exact replay or Bayesian TIE means no scientific superiority. This is a bounded direct-weight update mechanism; storing inferred parent IDs is not general intelligence, and excluding historical versions is not full lifelong retention.

controls: Direct: fixed shared 496 signed pair counters; for revised context, subtract old two stored pair weights, add newly fitted two pairs, preserving other 31 slots and aggregate exact count

Replay: reconstruct the entire shared 496 pair counter matrix from same 32 stored current law IDs after each revision, equal data, identical capacity and rules; independent reference implementation to avoid shared-bug tie
Naive-overwrite negative: overwrite shared matrix with only most recent context law, keep same total memory allocation; demonstrates destructive interference in global knowledge

Independent exact Bayesian posterior on all 107,880 public laws, with identical 2,048 observed source outcomes and action order; controls predictive accuracy; note this family oracle knows candidate grammar
Source-only 64-action exact active oracle upper confidence ceiling; stronger information than 4/8/12 prefixes, never offered as matched-information baseline
Shuffled context mapping, cold tamper-rejection, no-growth and duplicate old-to-new edge controls, original 24 plus eight revised contexts tested for effective rollback and no collateral changes
metrics: Exact held accuracy and posterior version-space candidate count for budgets 4,8,12,16,32,64 over 24+8 public DEV worlds (report all six prefixes, no post-result selection). Source law identification before scoring, no private law in fitting.

At 64 genuine interventions, >=90% 32 worlds uniquely identify law, >=0.98 mean held exact accuracy and at least 90% of 8 revised laws differ from old source law; otherwise stop at source/engineering gate.

Shared weights change on each 8 contradictory repairs; after all updates, full direct matrix must equal independently rebuilt conventional replay matrix; all 16 unaffected context programs predict identically to their before-snapshots, all 8 new revisions evaluate correctly at 64. Exact checksum and corruption negative.

Positive DEV engineering if all 8 subtract/add edits atomic, no replay needed to maintain exact counts, 16 unaffected current contexts retained 100%, no invalid law accepted and fixed 1120 raw memory bytes. Engineering feasibility != scientific benefit.

Scientific efficiency claim only if direct repair whole-process time <=0.5x fully qualified replay across both Linux/Windows at exact same candidate SHA with equal storage+history, while held accuracy and retention match exact control, independent prior/family transfer gains and reserved future blinded source replicate are independently established. Otherwise DEV_MIXED/NO_GO.
Uncertainty: never label selection within publicly known finite 4-parent grammar as outside-family new-law invention or protected scientific first-use.

classification_rules.supported: DEV_REPAIR_FEASIBLE only if 8/8 atomic in-place shared-weight edits preserve direct-vs-replay exact count equality, 16/16 unaffected context held prediction retention, all 8 revised worlds identified and correct with <=64 genuine actions, zero changed capacity, checksum/tamper PASS. SCIENTIFIC_PASS remains false until separately qualified independent source, matched end-to-end 2x advantage vs optimized replay and strong Bayesian controls.
classification_rules.mixed: Direct repair functional and cold retained but no 2x whole-process advantage over independent conventional replay, or loses to fully trained same-info Bayesian, or uses fitted old law IDs/known grammar: ENGINEERING_PASS/DEV_MIXED_NO_NATIVE_INTEGRATION.
classification_rules.negative: Any collateral old-current knowledge loss, 64-action insufficient law identification in >10% cases, held accuracy <0.98 at full budget, source hallucination, or direct global matrix differs from replay: DEV_NO_GO; preserve unchanged failed candidate.
classification_rules.invalid: Owner-private key/held labels leaked to learner, source index consumed outside allowed DEV seeds, hidden source law accessed by a learner, incomplete paid actions, data or capacity drift, prereg after DEV outcome, unverified exact source, no strong independent control, contaminated original FKP-06 seeds or original negative retuned: INVALID.
